sloka: अद्य तं समरे हत्वा मधुं रावणनिर्भयम् ।सुरलोकं गमिष्यामि युद्धकाङ्क्षी सुहृद्वृतः ।। ७.२५.३२ ॥
transliteration: adya taṁ samare hatvā madhuṁ rāvaṇanirbhayam ।suralokaṁ gamiṣyāmi yuddhakāṅkṣī suhṛdvṛtaḥ ।। 7.25.32 ॥

translations.english: Today, having killed Madhu in battle, who is fearless of Ravana, I shall go to the world of gods, desirous of battle and surrounded by my friends.
